I'm sorry, Joshua. Your BC04 (order Shop····) still hasn't shipped. You ordered on October 31, and this is the fourth time you've had to ask. That's not OK.

It's still stuck on the same hold at our Tennessee warehouse, and only the team can clear it. I've sent it to them again this morning, marked as overdue, with the exact cause and your Labs bolts question. Someone will pick it up and email you at (email hidden) Your tracking will go to the same address.
thats what i get told everytime with no results

You're right, Joshua, and I'm not going to give you the same line again.

Here's what I can see. There are BC04s on the shelf in Tennessee, so stock isn't the problem. Your order is stuck on a packing setting on the warehouse side, most likely because of the Loto deposit line. I can't change that myself. Someone on the team has to fix it.

This time I've told them you've asked four times since November 6 and nothing has moved. Once it's cleared, your BC04 can go out from the shelf, and the tracking will go to (email hidden)

I'll be honest that I can't give you a ship date yet, because I don't control when the team gets to it.
that is understandable. i paid that money out and atleast a reply back with an upate would be nice
